bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu; test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 60; rows=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -At -F '|' -c "SELECT chat_id,message_thread_id,message_id FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id BETWEEN 49 AND 104 AND state='published' AND pinned=TRUE AND message_id>0 AND token_hash IS NOT NULL ORDER BY message_thread_id" 2>/dev/null) || exit 61; test "$(printf '%s
' "$rows" | wc -l)" -eq 56 || exit 62; printf '%s
' "$rows" | docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const https=require("node:https");const token=process.env.BOT_TOKEN_FILE?fs.readFileSync(process.env.BOT_TOKEN_FILE,"utf8").trim():process.env.BOT_TOKEN;if(!/^[0-9]{7,15}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,100}$/.test(token||""))process.exit(70);function api(method,payload){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const body=JSON.stringify(payload);const req=https.request({hostname:"api.telegram.org",path:"/bot"+token+"/"+method,method:"POST",family:4,timeout:15000,headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json","Content-Length":Buffer.byteLength(body)}},res=>{let s="";res.setEncoding("utf8");res.on("data",d=>s+=d);res.on("end",()=>{let data={};try{data=JSON.parse(s)}catch{}resolve({status:res.statusCode,data})})});req.on("timeout",()=>req.destroy(new Error("TIMEOUT")));req.on("error",reject);req.end(body)})}let raw="";process.stdin.setEncoding("utf8");process.stdin.on("data",x=>raw+=x);process.stdin.on("end",async()=>{const rows=raw.trim().split("
").map(x=>x.split("|").map(Number));if(rows.length!==56||rows.some(r=>r.length!==3||!Number.isSafeInteger(r[1])||r[1]<1||!Number.isSafeInteger(r[2])||r[2]<1))process.exit(71);let ok=0;for(const [chat,thread,msg] of rows){let success=false;for(let attempt=0;attempt<4;attempt++){let response;try{response=await api("pinChatMessage",{chat_id:chat,message_id:msg,disable_notification:true})}catch(e){console.error("PIN_NETWORK_FAILED_THREAD",thread,"CONFIRMED",ok,"ERROR",e?.code||"UNKNOWN");process.exit(72)}if(response.data.ok===true){success=true;break}if(response.status===429){const wait=Math.max(1,Math.min(20,Number(response.data.parameters?.retry_after)||2));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,wait*1000));continue}console.error("PIN_API_FAILED_THREAD",thread,"CONFIRMED",ok,"HTTP",response.status,"TG_CODE",response.data.error_code||0);process.exit(73)}if(!success)process.exit(74);ok++;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150))}console.log("TELEGRAM_REPIN_CONFIRMED="+ok)});'
